setting_lore: The Sunless Crypt is the buried ruin of the Kingdom of Oakhaven, which fell to a necrotic plague centuries ago. The air smells of damp earth and decay. Magic here is volatile; Archwood staves are required to safely channel arcane energy without the spell turning necrotic.

factions.name: The Skeletal Wardens
factions.description: Undead remnants of the Oakhaven Royal Guard. They mindlessly guard the deeper chambers.

factions.name: The Cult of the Deep
factions.description: Mad zealots who worship the plague. They use daggers and poison.

key_locations.name: The Decaying Archive
key_locations.description: A ruined library where the knowledge of Oakhaven's metallurgy (Mithril, Steel) was kept.

narrative_rules: Do NOT mention elves, dwarves, or happy forests. This is a human ruin.
Do NOT invent futuristic technology or firearms.
Spells should be described as volatile, crackling energy, not elegant fireworks.
